report.compression: Draco 16-bit position / 12-bit normal quantization; no simplification
report.source: Z-Anatomy per-system glTF export (nqwrc/3d-anatomy), derived from BodyParts3D

registration.method: Uniform scale and translation fitted by least squares to bounding-box centres of bones present in both the Z-Anatomy skeletal export and the shipped BodyParts3D skeleton. No rotation (both are Y-up metre exports) and no per-structure adjustment.

report.coverage: Spinal cord with grey-matter columns and white-matter tracts, spinal roots and ganglia, cauda equina, cranial nerves I and III to XII with major branches, brachial plexus and upper limb nerves, sympathetic trunk, intercostal and lumbosacral nerves, lower limb nerves. Brain structures and the optic nerves remain the BodyParts3D selection.
limitations: Registered by one similarity transform fitted to bone centres; nerve courses relative to muscles and vessels are not independently reviewed.
Z-Anatomy groups some nerves (for example all intercostal nerves per side) into one surface; no synthetic splitting.
298 source nodes (brain, brainstem, eye and inner-ear structures) are intentionally not imported.
